title: 第15章 录事殿测验灵根第16章 师姐就是我的福缘
slug: 凡人修仙捡个仙子做老婆
content_zh:
石殿非常的宽敞，穹顶高达十数丈，只是这里没有特别装饰，显得非常空旷，昏暗色调更显得肃穆。
正中间是一座高高的石台，上面站着一个头发花白的紫袍老者，在他面前悬浮着一颗泛着灵光的灵球。
那应该就是测验灵根的东西。
石台周围延伸九条石桥，尽头是九座嵌进石壁的石门，分别刻着首阳、云居、青平、沧澜、奎阆、灵秀、清寒、太素、金玉。
散修拜师的过程很简单，登台测验骨龄和灵根，符合条件便可以接受九山盘问。
哪座山愿意要你，便是哪座山的记名弟子。
如果没人搭理，很抱歉，你落选了。
“谁先来？”
紫袍老者语气淡漠，透着股威严之势。
“我先。”
田九快步跑到石台上，朝着老者行礼：“长老好。”
紫袍老者面无表情，指了指旁边的石匣。
田九取出提前备好的灵石，放到里面。
紫袍老者挥手扫出一道灵光，确定灵石数额无误后，示意田九捧住面前灵珠。
通常情况，散修先是要测验骨龄的，但面前这个看起来也就十七八岁，便省了那道程序。
田九周身泛起耀眼的灵光，汇聚到灵珠，灵珠又腾起道道灵光，冲进了田九身体。
“嗡……”
伴随着一道轻微的嗡鸣声，紫袍老者手中的灵珠强光大盛，里面涌现出了明亮的火光。
“火灵根！”
“还是单灵根！”

石桥尽头的石门里，陆续出现了声音，显然都对这个衣着华贵的少年流露出了兴趣。
单灵根通常意味着更高的天赋。
而且看穿着，应该来自某个灵修世家，资源方面也会充裕，非常值得培养。
没想到今年收徒快要结束了，竟然来了一个不错的苗子。
“火灵根，四品！”
紫袍老者宣布了田九的天赋。
“四品火灵根，不错的天赋。田九，可愿来我云居山？”
“四品火灵根，可培养炼丹师。田九，我金玉山愿意接收你。”
…………
九山纷纷发出了邀请。
四品天赋，非常有望超脱灵源三境。
content_en:
The stone hall is very spacious, with a dome that is more than ten feet high. However, there is no special decoration here, so it looks very empty, and the dim tone makes it even more solemn.
In the middle is a high stone platform, on which stands an old man with gray hair in purple robes. In front of him is a spiritual ball floating with spiritual light.
That should be something to test your spiritual roots.
Nine stone bridges extend around the stone platform, and at the end are nine stone gates embedded in the stone wall, respectively engraved with Shouyang, Yunju, Qingping, Canglan, Kuilang, Lingxiu, Qinghan, Taisu, and Jinyu.
The process of apprenticeship for casual cultivators is very simple. They go on stage to test their bone age and spiritual roots. If they meet the conditions, they can be interrogated by Jiu Shan.
Whichever mountain wants you is its registered disciple.
If no one responds, I'm sorry, but you didn't get selected.
"Who comes first?"
The purple-robed old man's tone was indifferent, exuding a sense of majesty.
"Me first."
Tian Jiu quickly ran to the stone platform and saluted the old man: "Hello, elder."
The old man in purple robe had no expression on his face and pointed to the stone box next to him.
Tian Jiu took out the spiritual stones he had prepared in advance and put them inside.
The purple-robed old man waved his hand and swept out a spiritual light. After confirming that the amount of spiritual stones was correct, he motioned to Tian Jiu to hold the spiritual beads in front of him.
Normally, casual cultivators would first have to test their bone age, but the one in front of me looked about seventeen or eighteen years old, so that procedure was omitted.
Tian Jiu's whole body was filled with dazzling auras, which converged into the spirit beads. The auras of light from the beads flew into the air and rushed into Tian Jiu's body.
"Buzz..."
Along with a slight buzzing sound, the spirit pearl in the purple-robed old man's hand glowed brightly, and bright firelight emerged from it.
"Fire Spirit Root!"
"It's still a single spiritual root!"
From the stone gate at the end of the stone bridge, voices appeared one after another, obviously showing interest in this richly dressed young man.
Single spiritual root usually means higher talent.
And judging by his clothes, he should come from a spiritual family, and he would have abundant resources, so he is worth cultivating.
Unexpectedly, this year's apprenticeship recruitment is about to end, and a good seedling will appear.
"Fire Spirit Root, Fourth Grade!"
The purple-robed old man announced Tian Jiu’s talent.
"Fourth-grade fire spirit root, a good talent. Tian Jiu, would you like to come to my Yunju Mountain?"
"The fourth-grade fire spirit root can cultivate alchemists. Tian Jiu, I, Jinyu Mountain, are willing to accept you."
…………
Jiushan sent out invitations one after another.
The fourth-level talent is very promising to transcend the third level of spiritual source.
